title: nutty pickled german cheddar wrap
description: a pillowy, festive german dish featuring cheddar cheese and pickle, wrapped in a raw-friendly pandan leaf wrap
instructions: start by toasting the chopped almonds in a dry pan over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned.
in a large bowl, combine the grated german cheddar cheese, pickled cucumber slices, toasted almonds, and chopped parsley.
if using, stir in the mayonnaise or vegan alternative to help bind the filling together.
lay a pandan leaf wrap flat on a clean surface, with the stem end facing you.
place about 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture onto the center of the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
repeat with the remaining wraps and filling ingredients.
serve immediately, or wrap individually and refrigerate or freeze for later use.
